$comment: Asset manifest schema. Enforced by assets/asset_gate_lib.gd (this file is documentation; the gate is authoritative). Files starting with _ are ignored by the gate and registry.
generator: res:// path of the script/scene that produces the asset
seed: int (required for runtime_generator unless params given)
creator: who made it
reviewer: who reviewed; for approval must be non-empty and != creator (case-insensitive)
evidence_images: list of res:// PNGs of REAL renders, each file must exist, be loadable, >= 64x64 (required for approval)

<category>.evidence: >= 40 chars specific written justification, not generic

critical_failures: list; MUST be present for approval and MUST be empty
average_score: optional; if present must match computed mean (average never overrides a below-floor category)

validated_output_space.description: >= 40 chars: what range of outputs was validated
